title: The Midnight Express Train Stops
description:
📜 Anonymous Letter:
Train schedule:
10:00 PM - Departs Station A
10:30 PM - Arrives Station B
11:15 PM - Arrives Station C
12:00 AM - Arrives Station D
Suspect boarded at Station B and exited at the very next stop.
question: At which station did the suspect exit?
hints: The very next stop on the line is Station C (11:15 PM).
solution: Boarded at Station B (10:30 PM); the next stop is Station C at 11:15 PM.
